fix/edit-message-reply-markup-removal.reason: No PR upstream and 76 commits behind. Its main_api.tl:NNN citations fail the #537 guard, it names its sentinel `object` where upstream now uses MISSING, and it changes behaviour for callers already passing reply_markup=None (that would now remove the keyboard). The claim that an omitted field keeps the keyboard is server behaviour no offline test shows. Revisit if upstream opens a PR.
